Leaf Blast.organic_treatment: Use neem oil spray (2-3%), remove and destroy infected leaves, maintain proper plant spacing.
Leaf Blast.chemical_treatment: Apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane fungicides as per recommended dosage.

Bacterial Leaf Blight.organic_treatment: Use copper-based organic bactericides, practice crop rotation, avoid overhead irrigation.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.chemical_treatment: Apply streptomycin sulfate or copper oxychloride as per agricultural guidelines.

Brown Spot.organic_treatment: Apply compost tea or garlic extract spray, ensure proper fertilization.
Brown Spot.chemical_treatment: Use mancozeb or propiconazole fungicides at recommended intervals.

Tungro.cause: Virus (Rice tungro bacilliform virus + Rice tungro spherical virus) transmitted by green leafhoppers
Tungro.organic_treatment: Use reflective mulches to deter leafhoppers, remove infected plants, plant resistant varieties.
Tungro.chemical_treatment: Control leafhopper vectors with imidacloprid or thiamethoxam insecticides.

Sheath Blight.organic_treatment: Practice proper water management, use Trichoderma biofungicide, avoid excessive nitrogen.
Sheath Blight.chemical_treatment: Apply validamycin or hexaconazole fungicides during early stages of infection.

Healthy.organic_treatment: Maintain regular field monitoring and good agricultural practices.
